clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, Collin Mauren asks travelers bound for Kalimdor to bring him rare basilisk scales. He wants scales from the Charred Vale in Stonetalon to grind into dust for his spellcraft.

Collin Mauren, a wizard in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, listens to tales from wandering adventurers. He has heard that travelers are venturing deep into Kalimdor, where Stonetalon draws those seeking wild wyverns, unruly elementals, or deals and clashes with the Venture Company. Mauren is not after riches or glory. He wants to learn what rare natural wonders survive in the region's harshest corners.

The Charred Vale lies deep in Stonetalon, an ash-choked basin scarred by the Venture Company's devastation. Mauren's studies say a peculiar breed of basilisk once lived there. Their scales, crushed to a fine powder, can catalyze specialized arcane spells he has developed. He does not know whether the basilisks survived the Vale's harsh transformation, so he asks explorers to bring back fresh crystallised scales and learn whether the breed endures.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Travelers keep asking me about the Stonetalon Mountains. It seems to be a popular place for adventure--it doesn't matter if you're seeking wyvern, elementals, or you have business with the Venture Co.
Within the Charred Vale, deep in Stonetalon, there used to be a species of basilisks whose scales, when ground to dust, made a wonderful reagent for some spells I've created.
If those basilisks still live, I would love to have a few of their scales.
Take your time, it is no rush, but I can pay well.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you already returned from the Vale in Stonetalon with those scales?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is perfect, friend. Thank you greatly.
Perhaps one day in the future I'll be able to help you as you have helped me.
